correctness.rationale: PASS: The exact lattice-(1,1/2) Zak/Parseval multiplier is 2(|D_E-zeta E|^2+|D_O-zeta O|^2). The theta-product Wronskian has exactly one zero modulo the torus; at that fiber D_E=D_O=0 and the nonvanishing first-order real and imaginary derivatives are respectively u and iw. Strict positive real Hessian plus compactness localizes the true global minimum at |x|+|nu|=O(|zeta|). Orthogonal projection separately in real and imaginary coordinates gives 2 det(v,u)^2/||u||^2 (Re zeta)^2+2 det(v,w)^2/||w||^2 (Im zeta)^2 with phase-uniform O_gamma(|zeta|^3). The Wronskian simple-zero property establishes both coefficients >0 for every fixed gamma>0; no claim of gamma-uniformity or crossover uniqueness. Independent 45-digit series evaluation gives gamma=1: 1.569812175817728868 and 0.762904644807149990; gamma=pi: 0.244075617596902324 and 0.999958048135324132. Finite Zak minimizations/checker do not prove infinite theorem.

November 8 Gaussian/Hermite mixture theorem gives exact qualitative frame existence for every nonzero complex admixture, yet no sharp real-versus-imaginary second-order coefficient or its reversal with Gaussian width.
